title: Don’t pay for it
body:
Категорически не рекомендую покупать платную версию.
Во-первых, функционал не изменился от слова совсем.
Во-вторых, после последнего обновления пропала возможность редактирования привычек, просто пишет, что изменение невозможно и всё. Поддержка игнорит. Очень жалею о потраченных деньгах, самая бестолковая покупка в App Store. 

I strongly do not recommend purchasing the paid version.
Firstly, the functionality has not changed at all.
Secondly, after the last update, the ability to edit habits disappeared; it simply says that changing is impossible and that’s all. Support ignores. I really regret the money I spent, the most stupid purchase in the App Store.

author: yutdol

title: Nice Visual but Bad Experience.
body: You got asked for a lot of things for using the app for the first time but they didn’t help you anything. Plus, there is no tutorials. The app is quite repetitive in pursuing you to buy subscription with discount incentives without telling its benefits. How can I be confident to purchase if what I want is a tool, not the discount? The discount should come later to persuade customers… I found “Discover” mode which suggests task ideas but when I try to save it to my plan, it always redirects to purchasing subscription. Each task done is only in check boxes. I hope there are other type of goal such as percentage or numerical value. Perhaps it will be available only with subscription? Habits stat looks cute but it would be better to give data visualization of the overview of each task completion rate. Unfortunately, although the visual is nice and I like it very much but I found it can only help you with simple habit and simple tracking only.
